name: io.github.granitebps/video-understanding-mcp
title: Video Understanding MCP
description: Let AI agents watch videos and answer questions about them through any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint whose model accepts video, e.g. https://host/v1

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model (or router alias) to send videos to

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Endpoint API key, sent as a bearer token

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_PART_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: How the video is attached: video_url, image_url, file, or input_file

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_MAX_UPLOAD_MB
environmentVariables.description: Largest prepared video sent to the endpoint, in MB

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Directories local files may be read from; local files are refused when unset

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_VERIFY_MEDIA
environmentVariables.description: Fail calls when the endpoint evidently ignored the video
